description:
-Maintain existing Oracle Forms and Reports applications
 -Work on production support and trouble shoot production issues.
 -Develop SQL, PL/SQL scripts for data analysis and data cleanup as needed.
 -Work with other Software Engineers in identifying and resolving application issues.
 -Work with Project Managers to provide estimate of effort for work and progress of worker
 -Work with Business Analysts and business users to understand problems, enhancements and data changes requested.
 -Work with Quality Assurance and Release Coordinator to transition changes made from development to system test and to production.
 -Use incident tracking system JIRA to document changes made and progress
 -Use software version control SVN to track code changes.
 -Attend status meetings as required 

 Required skills:
 -Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or equivalent (minimum 3 years experience in Information Technology)
 -Minimum 3 years experience in Web deployed Oracle Forms and Reports development
 -Minimum 3 years experience using Oracle databases
 -Minimum 3 years experience in writing PL/SQL
 -Minimum 3 years experience using software development methodologies to perform analysis, design, construction and implementation of custom software
 

 Preferred skills:
 -Experience using Agile methodology is a plus
 -Experience designing systems around the use of automated workflow, document imaging, and custom business applications is a plus
 -Experience in the Financial/Retirement sector, including administration of retirement systems and/or health insurance is a plus
 -Proven ability to multi-task on concurrent projects 
 -Excellent oral and written communication skills
 -Participation in continued education will be considered a plus

 - "All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines". - All candidates who are authorized to work in US are encouraged to apply. - Candidates must clear the Background check prior to commencing the assignment.
